scope: Static selected mirrored full-stage source only; imported modules and firmware effects not exhaustively proved

effects.stage: Conditional GPT transformation and two-copy writes before later boot/RPMB checks
effects.readback_limit: Reparse/name checks, not verified original-state escrow or atomic rollback

effects.stage: Boot header clearing and RPMB zero/write/recheck shared by full and minimal paths
effects.restore_limit: RPMB/security state not covered by ordinary user/boot image copies

effects.stage: Full-only preloader copies, TEE and LK replacement
effects.restore_limit: Requires exact original identities and post-failure reachable restore, not supplied by script selection

effects.stage: Boot/recovery payload, MISC mode and preloader headers; reboot
